edits.find: - name: No change may turn a REJECT into an ALLOW
edits.add_before:
# PR-only, by construction. These three gates ask "does THIS change turn a
      # REJECT into an ALLOW, relative to main" -- `--baseline auto` resolves the
      # merge-base with main, which ON main is HEAD itself. The gate then reports
      # `SKIP: baseline resolves to HEAD - nothing to compare` and `--require-baseline`
      # correctly turns that skip into an error, so every push to main has failed this
      # job since at least 2026-08-23. The check is not being weakened: it already ran,
      # meaningfully, on the pull request that introduced the change. A permanently red
      # main is a gate nobody reads.

edits.find:
- name: No change may turn a REJECT into an ALLOW
        run: python3 scripts/check-validator-differential.py --baseline auto --max-len 3 --require-baseline
edits.replace:
- name: No change may turn a REJECT into an ALLOW
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
        run: python3 scripts/check-validator-differential.py --baseline auto --max-len 3 --require-baseline

edits.find:
- name: No change may unprotect a file without disclosing it
        run: python3 scripts/check-protected-differential.py --baseline auto --require-baseline
edits.replace:
- name: No change may unprotect a file without disclosing it
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
        run: python3 scripts/check-protected-differential.py --baseline auto --require-baseline

edits.find:
- name: No change may un-flag a secret without disclosing it
        run: python3 scripts/check-fileguard-differential.py --baseline auto --require-baseline
edits.replace:
- name: No change may un-flag a secret without disclosing it
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
        run: python3 scripts/check-fileguard-differential.py --baseline auto --require-baseline
